enemies.name: Pack Animal

special_abilities.name: Howl
special_abilities.text: Once per combat, this animal may let out a loud cry, bringing two more animals from the same pack running into combat. Only one pack animal may use this ability.

enemies.notes: Pack animals tend to travel in groups. Most encounters utilizing them should have a minimum of three.

enemies.name: Elemental Ursine

special_abilities.name: Elemental Shift
special_abilities.text: During its turn, this creature may freely change its elemental affinity.

enemies.notes: Ursine are afraid of things larger than them and will be hesitant to approach large creatures. Affinities: See special abilities.

enemies.name: Novice Bearer

special_abilities.name: Special Attack
special_abilities.text: Once in combat, hit a 3x3 square with an attack of 3 (only if their Blade is fighting too).

enemies.notes: This Bearer should be roughly equal in strength to a freshly-rolled Bearer made with the Fresh Face guidelines. Affinities: Pick one. Best attributes: Pick any one or two. Art tags: Pick three.

enemies.name: Forgeling Blade

special_abilities.name: Special Attack
special_abilities.text: Once in combat, hit a 3x3 square with an attack 3 (only if their Bearer is fighting too).

enemies.notes: This Blade should be roughly equal in strength to a freshly-rolled Blade made with the Fresh Face guidelines. Affinities: Pick one. Best attributes: Pick any one or two. Art tags: Pick three.

enemies.name: Blade Eater

special_abilities.name: Radius Hop
special_abilities.text: Move up to two squares before attacking, then move four more after.

enemies.notes: The Blade Eater has properties of both a Bearer and Blade, but can be overconfident. Affinities: Pick one to three. Best attributes: Pick any one or two.

enemies.name: Legendary Bearer

special_abilities.name: Special Attack
special_abilities.text: Once per combat, attack 8 on a 5x5 area (only if their Blade is conscious).

enemies.notes: This Bearer should be a challenging boss encounter for a seasoned group. Affinities: Pick one to three. Best attributes: Pick any one or two. Art tags: Use as many as you'd like.

enemies.name: Titanic Blade

special_abilities.name: Orbital Death Beam
special_abilities.text: Has the talent Orbital Death Beam.

special_abilities.name: Special Attack
special_abilities.text: Once per combat, attack 8 on a 5x5 area (only if their Bearer is conscious).

enemies.notes: This Blade should be a challenging boss encounter for a seasoned group. Affinities: Pick two to four. Best attributes: Pick any one or two. Art tags: Use as many as you'd like.

enemies.name: Rockbart

special_abilities.name: Aggressive Scream
special_abilities.text: Once per combat, gives all players -1 to all rolls until its next turn.

enemies.notes: The Rockbart is extremely territorial. Parties should expect to treat it as a threat meant to keep them out of areas, an obstacle to sneak around, or a very challenging encounter for end-game players.
